title: Verify the bounded native collaboration workflow
scope: Close the actual file-recovered implementation, failed audit, bounded repair, and fresh passing re-audit trace.
acceptance: The workflow limits concurrent delegated agents to three and assigns one write owner per path.
Independent audit is read-only, reports failures without fixing them, and cannot self-approve implementation work.
Fresh agents recover implementation and audit work from task, handoff, and evidence files without conversation history.
The built Plugin carries and bundle-only validates the minimal recovery Schema closure without a daemon or concrete model identifier.
